title: Linux local administration v1
description: One request and one response per Unix connection. Each document is UTF-8 JSON preceded by a 4-byte big-endian unsigned byte length in 1..1048576. Only the service effective UID is permitted. No credentials, arbitrary SQL or remote transport. Dynamic JSON documents have no parallel handwritten DTO.

page.description: Canonical page number, 0..1000000, fixed 100 items per page. Live offset pagination, not a consistent snapshot.

result.description: status: phase/root_count/recovery_detail; roots: existing OpenAPI RootList plus next_page; registration: existing OpenAPI RootRegistered; paged reads: items/next_page/recovery_detail. History items whitelist version_id, entry_id, size, created_seq, origin, superseded_at. Trash items whitelist entry_id, path, kind, version_id, deleted_at, expires_at. Problems items are root_health (root_id/health/reason, live mount identity and readability probe) or persisted conflict (root_id/entry_id/copy_entry_id/path/reason). No user, password, hash or session records.
